report.summary: Patient P-D011 (age 34, commercial high-deductible plan with no transport benefit) screened positive for a transportation need today. Home tract 17031062000 has high vehicle-insecurity (47.6% of households with no vehicle) but strong transit access (88 stops within 800m, 87 with early service). No upcoming appointments to verify transit timing. Eligibility checked where possible: Medicaid Ride Line not eligible (not Medicaid); Senior Shuttle West not eligible (under 60). Paratransit options remain available pending disability assessment.

options.name: Paratransit interest form
options.how_to_access: Clinic staff complete the Paratransit interest form (http://127.0.0.1:32927/forms/H5) with patient full name, date of birth, phone, and disability description; response within one business day.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA certification)
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Not eligible for this patient (commercial insurance, not Medicaid). Medicaid plan members call the number on their card at least 2 business days ahead.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Not eligible for this patient (age 34; service is for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM-5 PM).
